power.method: PoE (802.3at, Type 2, Class 4), max. 16W, or 12 VDC max. 16.4W, or 24 VAC max. 16.1W

features: DeepinViewX 4MP motorized-varifocal (P-iris) vandal dome with dedicated Guanlan large-scale AI model for perimeter protection (~90% fewer false alarms)
AI Encoding — cuts storage ~50% while preserving human/vehicle image quality
multi-target-type detection — simultaneous human body, face and vehicle capture with feature extraction
face capture (up to 60 faces), regional people counting, heat map, on/off duty detection, AcuSeek search (with AcuSeek NVR/servers)
perimeter protection: line crossing, intrusion, region entrance/exiting
AI Open Platform — 4 loadable model packages
hybrid supplement light — IR + white light up to 40m (2.8-12mm) / 60m (8-32mm), smart supplement light, 850nm IR
-H startup/operating to -40°C (heater), -S strobe/audible warning, -Y NEMA 4X anti-corrosion

home_assistant.notes: Use ONVIF integration. Default ONVIF port 80.

release_notes: 4MP DeepinViewX motorized-varifocal (P-iris, 2.8-12mm or 8-32mm) vandal dome for perimeter protection (Guanlan model) with face capture, people counting, heat map, AI Encoding, 140 dB WDR. -H heater, -S strobe, -Y NEMA 4X anti-corrosion. Specs verified against the official Hikvision datasheet iDS-2CD5146G2_V-XZHSY_Datasheet_20260807.
